items.title: Streeting denies 'kicking can down the road' in defence spending row
items.summary: The government is under pressure to set out a path to greater defence spending, as ministers unveil plans to boost UK firms.

items.title: Crypto industry suffers 'largest bank heist in human history'
items.summary: Cryptocurrency worth more than $6.3bn (£4.7bn) has been stolen from a major exchange - with one industry insider telling Sky News it is "the largest bank heist in human history".

items.title: Yorkshire Water boss resigns after firm downgraded
items.summary: Nicola Shaw, who has led the company since 2022, will step down in January, it is announced.

items.title: Police investigating Andrew's Balmoral stays with Epstein and Maxwell
items.summary: Police are investigating Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's stays with Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell at Balmoral.

items.title: 'I run a spotless kitchen', says Michelin-star restaurant chef in wake of food hygiene debacle
items.summary: Chef Gareth Ward defends how he operates in documentary after Ynyshir got a one-star hygiene rating.

items.title: Star Trek and X-Men actor Sir Patrick Stewart dies
items.summary: Star Trek and X-Men actor Sir Patrick Stewart has died after a "brief and poignant journey" with Alzheimer's and dementia.
